intro: This respected tauren elder is known as Seer Wiserunner, serving his people faithfully in the rolling hills of Mulgore. From a cave in the hills northwest of Bloodhoof Village, he aids young tauren braves as they undertake the traditional rites of passage that lead toward spiritual adulthood.

sections.t: A Guide on the Sacred Path
p: Seer Wiserunner stands among the gentle bluffs of Mulgore as an elder and mystic of the shu'halo. When young hunters and shamans complete their initial trials of strength and vision, they are sent to seek his counsel during their ancestral rites. He interprets visions of the Earth Mother and guides the youth on how to honor their forebears, offering the steady wisdom that binds the scattered nomadic tribes into a unified community.
